about: The only place a GoIDEA status is raised in OPENIDEA_PARITY_MATRIX.md. Keys are kind:id; a non-missing status must carry evidence (a regression check id from REGRESSION_INDEX.json, a document, or a source path). Everything absent here is reported as missing. Start conservative: `partial` when only part of the OpenIDEA surface is proven, `integrated` when a gate check exercises it.

keymap-preset:intellij-macos.evidence: internal/app/keymap_presets_generated.go ships the complete pinned 370-binding IntelliJ macOS preset plus the Windows, Eclipse and VS Code presets. TestKeymapPresetRegistryMatchesPinnedOpenIDEASet, TestKeymapPresetSurfacesShowAllSixChoices and TestKeymapPresetChangeRefreshesTheSharedNativeMenu cover the generated bindings and native keymap selection

feature:github.evidence: internal/github/review_requests.go and queries.go implement REST pull request patches, GraphQL review threads and pending-review lookup, inline comment creation, review submission, thread resolve/unresolve, metadata/base editing, current-branch lookup and timeline comments. internal/app/github_review.go, github_review_actions.go and github_review_view.go provide Review Mode, review and normal diffs, single/multiline comments, comment navigation, approval/change-request/comment submission, thread resolution, field editing and timeline comments. The behavior follows third_party/openidea/src/features/github/reviewMode, diff, timeline, details and api. TestPullRequestFilesUsesBoundedRESTPagesAndMapsPatches, TestReviewThreadsPaginateAndMapCommentMetadata, TestReviewMutationsSendExactGraphQLInputs, TestReviewRESTOperationsUseExactPathsAndBodies, TestGitHubReviewSurfacesRenderOffscreen, TestGitHubReviewActionsSubmitResolveUpdateAndComment and TestGitHubReviewMutationsIgnoreAStalePullRequest cover the HTTP boundary, rendering and stale replies. Real mutation permissions, branch protection, line anchoring, rate limits and visual parity remain

toolwindow:pullRequests.evidence: internal/app/github_view.go registers Pull Requests in the dock's left primary slot, with token setup, filters, details, files, review and normal diffs, threads, metadata/review forms, timeline comments and the create form. TestGitHubPullRequestsDockMovesThroughTheLeftPrimaryArea covers opening, hiding, moving to the right, returning to the left and surviving hide/show. TestGitHubToolWindowRendersNativeStatesOffscreen covers major states. Visual comparison with OpenIDEA remains

action:github.refresh.evidence: internal/app/github.go refreshes the current native list, detail or create view and TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered covers registration; TestGitHubConnectLoadsRepositoryAndFirstSearchPage proves the first-load request path. Refresh behavior against a real GitHub account remains unverified

action:github.createPullRequest.evidence: internal/app/github.go opens the native create form, loads repository branches and posts title, body, base, head and draft through internal/github/requests.go; TestGitHubCreateViewedAndUpdateBranchFlows covers the REST payload, detail transition and native state

action:github.pullRequest.showInToolWind.evidence: internal/app/github.go opens the Pull Requests dock in the left primary area and loads a requested pull request number. TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered, TestGitHubConnectLoadsRepositoryAndFirstSearchPage and TestGitHubPullRequestsDockMovesThroughTheLeftPrimaryArea cover registration, current-branch lookup, dock placement and detail loading inputs

action:github.pullRequest.refresh.evidence: internal/app/github.go reloads the selected pull request detail; TestGitHubCreateViewedAndUpdateBranchFlows covers the detail query and state transition, while TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered covers the native action

action:github.pullRequest.timeline.refre.evidence: internal/app/github.go reloads timeline and review data through the pull request GraphQL document; TestGitHubCreateViewedAndUpdateBranchFlows covers detail parsing and TestGitHubToolWindowRendersNativeStatesOffscreen covers the Activity and Reviews sections

action:github.pullRequest.diff.refreshRe.evidence: internal/app/github.go registers Refresh Review Data. The action reloads pull request detail, REST file patches, review threads and the pending review. TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered and TestGitHubReviewRefreshIgnoresAStalePullRequest cover registration and stale replies; live GitHub refresh remains unverified

action:github.pullRequest.diff.addCommen.evidence: internal/app/github_review.go opens a single-line draft at the selected old or new diff line and internal/github/review_requests.go creates a pending review or submitted COMMENT review. TestReviewMutationsSendExactGraphQLInputs, TestGitHubReviewActionsSubmitResolveUpdateAndComment and TestGitHubReviewSurfacesRenderOffscreen cover the API, orchestration and native editor. Real line anchoring remains unverified

action:github.pullRequest.diff.addMultil.evidence: internal/app/github_review.go and github_diff.go select the preceding same-side line, expose editable start/end values and send startLine/startSide with the end line/side. TestGitHubPatchLinesMultilineDraftsAndThreadNavigation, TestReviewMutationsSendExactGraphQLInputs and TestGitHubReviewSurfacesRenderOffscreen cover ranges, request payloads and native rendering. Real outdated and multiline anchoring remains unverified

action:github.pullRequest.diff.nextComme.evidence: internal/app/github_review.go orders threads by file and line and reveals the selected thread's file and diff row. TestGitHubPatchLinesMultilineDraftsAndThreadNavigation covers ordering, selection and the end boundary

action:github.pullRequest.diff.previousC.evidence: internal/app/github_review.go reuses the file-and-line thread order in the reverse direction. TestGitHubPatchLinesMultilineDraftsAndThreadNavigation and TestGitHubReviewSurfacesRenderOffscreen cover navigation state and the native Previous control

action:github.pullRequest.reviewMode.evidence: internal/app/github_review.go resolves the open pull request for the current branch, exposes Review Mode in the status bar and toolbar, opens the left Pull Requests dock and records the branch state. TestGitHubConnectLoadsRepositoryAndFirstSearchPage covers the branch lookup and TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered covers registration. Real remote-tracking, fork-head and unsynchronised-branch behavior remains unverified

action:github.pullRequest.reviewMode.sho.evidence: internal/app/github_review_actions.go switches to review diff, selects the first changed file when needed and opens the left Pull Requests dock. TestGitHubActionsAndToolWindowAreRegistered and TestGitHubReviewSurfacesRenderOffscreen cover registration, review mode and the native diff

action:github.pullRequest.toggleViewed.evidence: internal/app/github.go calls GitHub's markFileAsViewed or unmarkFileAsViewed GraphQL mutation and updates the native file row; TestGitHubCreateViewedAndUpdateBranchFlows covers the selected-file mutation and TestGitHubToolWindowRendersNativeStatesOffscreen covers the Files section

action:github.pullRequest.updateBranch.evidence: internal/app/github.go exposes Update Branch only for BEHIND pull requests and internal/github/requests.go sends the expected head SHA to GitHub's update-branch REST endpoint; TestGitHubCreateViewedAndUpdateBranchFlows covers the request and refreshed detail, while real-account mergeability remains unverified

action:file.exportSettings.evidence: internal/app/parity_file_find_window_actions.go and parity_settings_actions.go expose the native save flow, include GoIDEA preferences and templates, and call settings_export. TestSettingsBundleExportImportRoundTripsPreferencesAndTemplates covers action registration, bundle storage and the RPC boundary

action:file.importSettings.evidence: internal/app/parity_settings_actions.go opens the native chooser, calls settings_import, restores GoIDEA preferences and templates, applies preferences and reports the restart requirement. TestSettingsBundleExportImportRoundTripsPreferencesAndTemplates covers the import path and restored state

action:file.importJetBrainsSettings.evidence: internal/app/parity_settings_actions.go lists installed JetBrains settings directories, renders the native IDE chooser and confirmation summary, and writes the mapped global settings. The v0.1.54 backend supplies settings_list_jetbrains_ides and settings_read_jetbrains for both folders and exported settings.zip archives. TestJetBrainsSettingsPlanRendersConfirmsAndAppliesGlobalWrites covers nine mapped options and writes, while TestIntegrationGlobalSettingsAndJetBrainsImport proves directory discovery plus real folder and ZIP extraction against the shipped backend

action:file.newProjectsSettings.evidence: internal/app/settings_ui.go opens the native Settings for New Projects sheet, and internal/app/settings_native_catalog.go forces every requested and written property to the global scope while that mode is active. TestNewProjectsSettingsUsesGlobalJavaScopeAndTitle covers the native Java entry, and TestNewProjectsSettingsForceEveryPageToGlobalScope covers a mixed project/global page

action:file.openInNewWindow.evidence: cmd/goidea/windows.go creates an independent native window, model, session and openidea-server, and internal/app/workspace_host.go routes File › Open Project in New Window through it. TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost and the real-server windows.distinctProjects/windows.distinctBackends checks cover the action. macOS hidden-window acceptance is proven; other platforms remain unverified

action:file.renameProject.evidence: internal/app/parity_file_find_window_actions.go provides the native Rename Project prompt and direct argument path, then calls project_rename and applies the returned identity. TestProjectRenamePromptAndDirectRPCUpdateProjectIdentity covers rendering, payload, response and title state

action:file.togglePowerSave.evidence: internal/app/parity_file_find_window_actions.go writes global general.powerSaveMode and suppresses completion, hover documentation, quick documentation, quick definition, usage highlights, code vision and inline completion. TestPowerSaveWritesGlobalSettingStopsEditorSurfacesAndPersists covers the RPC, local persistence and surface state; changes made by another client do not update this native toggle without an action refresh

TestDebugConfigurationActionUsesTheExplicitRunConfig proves the explicit id reaches that route, while debug.* release checks cover the live JVM session

action:run.stopProcess.evidence: OpenIDEA's run.stopProcess aliases run.stop. internal/app/run.go StopProcess accepts numeric, JSON-number and string process ids, stops the owned session through StopRun or sends run_stop for a background id. TestRunActionArgumentsReachTheNativeFlows verifies the native action and exact run_stop payload

action:gradle.analyzeDependencies.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.analyzeDependencies to the native Dependency Analyzer. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves the command entry and analyzer state, while TestDependencyAnalyzerUsesGradleDependencyRPC and TestDependencyAnalyzerStopCancelsTheGradleRequest cover the real RPC payload and cancellation path

action:gradle.cancelReload.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.cancelReload to CancelBuildToolReload. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves the action clears live sync state and sends cancel_request

action:gradle.collapseAll.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.collapseAll to CollapseGradleAll. TestBuildToolCollapseKeepsTheOtherTreeExpanded proves that it closes every Gradle row without changing Maven expansion

action:gradle.executeTask.evidence: internal/app/build_tool_actions.go opens the native Gradle window and Run Anything with the gradle prefix. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState verifies the action route, active tool and query

action:gradle.expandAll.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.expandAll to the native Gradle tree expansion. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState supplies a real Gradle project tree and verifies that nested Gradle rows become expanded

action:gradle.reload.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.reload to SyncGradle. TestBuildSyncUsesTheRealToolbarArguments and TestBuildModelAutoSyncsTheVisibleToolFirst prove the build model RPC payload, independent build roots and resulting native model

action:gradle.toggleOffline.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.toggleOffline to the independent Gradle offline switch, and TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState plus TestBuildSyncUsesTheRealToolbarArguments prove the action state and build_sync payload. The switch is still session-only instead of project-persisted like OpenIDEA

action:gradle.toggleSkipTests.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes gradle.toggleSkipTests to the Gradle-specific switch, and TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves it does not change Maven state. The switch still lacks OpenIDEA's project-level persistence

action:maven.analyzeDependencies.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.analyzeDependencies to the native Dependency Analyzer. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves the command entry and analyzer state, and TestMavenDependencyNavigationAndExclusionRPCArguments covers declaration, exclusion and native navigation payloads

action:maven.cancelReload.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.cancelReload to CancelBuildToolReload. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves the action clears live sync state and sends cancel_request

action:maven.collapseAll.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.collapseAll to CollapseMavenAll. TestBuildToolCollapseKeepsTheOtherTreeExpanded proves that it closes every Maven row without changing Gradle expansion

action:maven.executeGoal.evidence: internal/app/build_tool_actions.go opens the native Maven window and Run Anything with the mvn prefix. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState verifies the action route, active tool and query

action:maven.expandAll.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.expandAll to the native Maven tree expansion. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState supplies a real reactor tree and verifies that nested Maven rows become expanded

action:maven.generateSources.evidence: internal/app/build_tool_actions.go routes maven.generateSources to the selected-POM or all-project native run queue. TestGenerateMavenSourcesRunsEveryTopLevelProjectThenReloads, TestGenerateMavenSourcesSelectedPOMRunsOnceAndReloads, TestGenerateMavenSourcesDoesNotReloadWhenEveryProjectFails and TestGenerateMavenSourcesStopsTheQueueWhenStopped cover sequencing, scope, reload and cancellation

action:maven.reload.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.reload to SyncMaven. TestBuildSyncUsesTheRealToolbarArguments proves the build_sync payload, profile selection, request channel and resulting native model

action:maven.settings.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.settings to the native Java settings page where Maven configuration lives. TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState verifies the action route and page selection

action:maven.toggleOffline.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.toggleOffline to the Maven offline switch, and TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState plus TestBuildSyncUsesTheRealToolbarArguments prove the action state and build_sync payload. The switch is still session-only instead of project-persisted like OpenIDEA

action:maven.toggleSkipTests.evidence: internal/app/commands.go routes maven.toggleSkipTests to the Maven-specific switch, and TestOpenIDEABuildToolCommandsReachNativeState proves it does not change Gradle state. The switch still lacks OpenIDEA's project-level persistence

action:find.field.newLine.evidence: internal/app/view.go uses a growing native TextArea and supports enter to search plus Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter to insert a line. TestFindFieldEnterRunsSearchAndShortcutAddsNewLine and TestFindFieldNewLineHistoryAndScrollStatePersist cover keyboard and action paths

action:find.field.recentSearches.evidence: internal/app/search.go persists up to twenty exact multiline queries and internal/app/view.go renders native recent-search rows. TestFindFieldNewLineHistoryAndScrollStatePersist covers persistence, opening, selection and multiline rendering

action:find.openInWindow.evidence: internal/app/parity_file_find_window_actions.go transfers an explicit or selected multiline query into GoIDEA's native bottom Find window and runs it there. TestOpenFindResultsInWindowCarriesMultilineQuery covers the native action and exact search payload

action:find.scrollToResults.evidence: internal/app/search.go tracks the default-on follow-results preference and internal/app/view.go scrolls the selected native result into view. TestFindFieldNewLineHistoryAndScrollStatePersist covers action state, rendering and the off-mode label

action:window.detachTab.evidence: internal/app/parity_window_groups.go captures the selected file tab's unsaved text, selections, scroll, pin and preview state, asks WorkspaceHost to restore it in an independent native project window, and removes the source tab only after the target accepts the snapshot. The standalone editor-group move remains a fallback; TestWindowCompatibilityActionsTargetProjectsAndPreserveEditorTabs and TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost cover the native host route, and workspace smoke proves independent project windows and backends.

action:window.mergeAllWindows.evidence: internal/app/parity_window_groups.go calls WorkspaceHost.MergeProjectWindows while retaining every model and backend, and keeps the editor-group merge as the standalone fallback. TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost covers the native host route and the workspace smoke verifies independent project windows and backend ownership.

action:window.new.evidence: cmd/goidea/windows.go creates a Welcome model and native window with its own backend, and internal/app/workspace_host.go routes Window › New Window to it. TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost and the real-server windows.newWindow/windows.windowNext checks prove an empty third window, independent PID and native focus cycling. macOS hidden-window acceptance is proven; other platforms remain unverified

action:window.next.evidence: internal/app/workspace_host.go focuses the next native project window and falls back to editor groups only for standalone models. TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost covers native delegation and the real-server windows.windowNext check proves focus moved to another project window

action:window.previous.evidence: internal/app/workspace_host.go focuses the previous native project window and falls back to editor groups only for standalone models. TestNativeProjectWindowActionsUseTheWorkspaceHost covers the native delegation and previous direction

action:editor.encodings.toggleNativeToAs.evidence: internal/app/settings_encoding_action.go registers OpenIDEA's action, stages the page checkbox value when Settings supplies pageId/scope/value, and otherwise writes editor.encodings.nativeToAscii immediately in project scope or global scope without a project; TestNativeToAsciiActionStagesOnEncodingPage and TestNativeToAsciiActionWritesProjectOrGlobalScope cover both paths

setting:editor.encodings.global.evidence: internal/app/file_encoding.go loads editor.encodings.global from settings_get_global for standalone documents, keeps the detected encoding and BOM on save, and internal/app/settings_backend_catalog.go invalidates that cache after Settings writes. TestFileEncodingSettingsUseTheGlobalBackendSettings, TestFileEncodingSettingsRefreshAfterSettingsWrites, TestStandaloneDocumentsDecodeGlobalAndPropertiesBytes and TestStandaloneDocumentsSniffAndPreserveBOMlessUTF16 cover the native runtime, and TestIntegrationFileEncodingsDriveDocumentsAndNewFiles proves the pinned backend decodes a Windows-1252 .txt outside the project through the exact global setting key

setting:editor.encodings.nativeToAscii.evidence: internal/app/settings_native_catalog.go edits the setting and internal/app/settings_encoding_action.go provides OpenIDEA's standalone toggle action; TestNativeToAsciiActionStagesOnEncodingPage and TestNativeToAsciiActionWritesProjectOrGlobalScope cover page staging, scope and the exact settings_set key and value

setting:editor.encodings.project.evidence: Project documents use the pinned backend's editor.encodings.project fallback, and standalone save-through preserves the effective encoding. TestEncodedProjectTextOpensThroughDocOpenInsteadOfHex proves encoded text reaches doc_open instead of the hex viewer, TestNewEmptyFileDefersEncodingAndBOMToBackendCreateFile proves empty creation uses fs_create_file, and TestIntegrationFileEncodingsDriveDocumentsAndNewFiles proves GBK project decoding and both UTF-8 BOM policies with exact settings_set keys and file bytes

setting:editor.encodings.properties.evidence: internal/app/file_encoding.go applies editor.encodings.properties to standalone .properties documents and preserves the detected encoding when saving. TestStandaloneDocumentsDecodeGlobalAndPropertiesBytes covers the native path and exact saved bytes, while TestIntegrationFileEncodingsDriveDocumentsAndNewFiles proves the pinned backend applies the properties override inside a project

setting:editor.encodings.utf8Bom.evidence: internal/app/project_tree_actions.go creates empty files through fs_create_file so the pinned backend applies its Create UTF-8 files policy. TestNewEmptyFileDefersEncodingAndBOMToBackendCreateFile proves the exact RPC and TestIntegrationFileEncodingsDriveDocumentsAndNewFiles proves always and never policies produce a UTF-8 BOM or an empty file for UTF-8 project encoding

editor-contribution:dependency-versions.evidence: internal/app/dependencies.go contributes manifest version completion and Cargo update quick fixes through the native editor completion and intent hooks; TestDependencyManifestNamesMatchOpenIDEA, TestDependencyCompletionPreservesOperatorAndFiltersTypedVersion, TestDependencyCompletionUsesUTF16OffsetsAroundAstralText and TestDependencyIntentBuildsCargoUpdateQuickFix cover the native contribution

editor-contribution:http.requests.evidence: internal/app/http_editor.go contributes request parsing, run gutters, the environment toolbar and cURL paste handling to MyGo's native editor; internal/app/http_client_test.go covers request-at-caret selection, environment persistence and the backend request launch

editor-contribution:http.endpoints.evidence: internal/app/http_endpoints.go contributes HTTP method, URL, header, media-type and backend-route completions, while internal/app/view.go paints endpoint gutters; TestHTTPEndpointCompletionTargetsOnlyFirstRequestURL, TestHTTPHeaderCompletionTargetsNamesAndValues, TestHTTPEndpointRenderNormalizesPathVariable and TestPluginEndpointGutterGroupsRoutesByNativeLine cover the native editor contribution

editor-contribution:http.spring.evidence: internal/app/http_spring.go parses Java and Kotlin Spring mappings, request parts, server configuration and JSON bodies, and internal/app/view.go exposes append and gutter actions; TestSpringParsesJavaMappingsAndRequestParts, TestSpringParsesKotlinMappingsAndDataClassBodies, TestSpringBodyLookupBuildsOrderedJSON, TestSpringAppendAndGutterMarksFollowOpenIDEA and TestSpringEditorMenuAndActionsAreRegistered cover the contribution

editor-contribution:macros.recorder.evidence: internal/app/macros.go records ordered native action, text and key steps from the editor; TestMacroRecordingMergesTextKeepsKeysAndPersistsNamedMacros and TestMacroArgumentsAndEditorKeysMatchOpenIDEA cover recording, canonical keys and persistence

editor-contribution:merge-conflict-marke.evidence: internal/app/vcs_more.go parses classic and diff3 conflict markers and contributes caret resolution, next and previous navigation through the native VCS actions; TestParseConflictMarkersSupportsClassicAndDiff3 and merge_editor_test.go cover marker parsing and conflict resolution

editor-contribution:plugins.decorations.evidence: internal/app/plugin_visuals.go renders plugin text and line decorations through native MyGo backgrounds, hover cards, gutter dots and a multi-target chooser, with UTF-16 ranges, deterministic marker-icon fallback colors, version guards and a 64-path indexed batch. plugin_visuals_test.go covers provider RPCs, decoration ranges, marker grouping, stale replies, refresh events and bounded requests. MyGo has no after-text widget or arbitrary span text styling, and the pinned JSON-RPC surface has no plugin_assets call for declared SVG marker icons

editor-contribution:services.composeEdit.evidence: internal/app/docker_compose_editor.go contributes Docker Compose key, value, service, network, volume, config, secret and extends references through MyGo completion; TestDockerComposeEditorCompletesAndResolvesReferences covers completion filtering, reference resolution and comment exclusion

editor-contribution:services.dockerGutte.evidence: internal/app/docker_gutter.go paints Dockerfile and Compose run/build/debug menus in the native gutter; TestDockerGutterActionsMatchOpenIDEA and TestDockerGutterRendersNativeRunMenu cover actions and rendering

editor-contribution:viewers.markdownLive.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go renders one live Markdown buffer as editor, split or native rich-text preview without copying unsaved text; TestMarkdownNativeLayoutActionsRenderOneDocument and TestMarkdownActionsFollowOpenIDEAArguments cover the native viewer contribution

editor-contribution:web.djangoContent.evidence: internal/app/web_django.go detects Django template tags above the native editor and offers Keep as HTML or Use Django Template; TestDjangoContentDetectsTagsAndOffersNativeFileTypeChoices covers detection, rendering and the persisted file-type choice

editor-kind:notebook.evidence: internal/app/notebook.go registers .ipynb tabs as a native notebook editor; TestNotebookOpenRoutesLoadsAndRendersNativeCells covers loading, routing and cell rendering

file-editor:notebook.evidence: internal/app/app.go routes .ipynb through openNotebook before the text-document registry; notebook_test.go covers the native provider end to end

file-editor:viewers.hex.evidence: internal/app/app.go probes files through internal/vfs and routes binary or over-8-MB content to openHexViewer; TestBinaryViewerUsesVirtualizedNativeHexRows covers the native provider

file-editor:viewers.image.evidence: internal/app/app.go routes supported image extensions to openImageViewer before document loading; TestImageViewerAndActionsUseTheNativeTab covers the native provider

action:image.fitToWindow.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go registers Fit Zoom to Window and restores contained rendering; TestImageViewerAndActionsUseTheNativeTab verifies the result

action:image.toggleChessboard.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go registers Show Chessboard and toggles the native viewer background; TestImageViewerAndActionsUseTheNativeTab verifies action state and rendering

action:image.zoomIn.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go registers Zoom In with bounded native image scaling; TestImageViewerAndActionsUseTheNativeTab verifies the result

action:image.zoomOut.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go registers Zoom Out with bounded native image scaling; TestImageViewerAndActionsUseTheNativeTab covers registration and the shared zoom route

action:markdown.previewOnly.evidence: internal/app/viewers.go renders Markdown as a native rich-text page without a second copy of the buffer; TestMarkdownNativeLayoutActionsRenderOneDocument and TestMarkdownActionsFollowOpenIDEAArguments cover the native preview and path argument

TestOpenIDEAPluginServicesContentActionsUseRegisteredController covers registration, controller dispatch and the no-surface status. A native plugin content editor surface remains absent

action:plugins.content.find.evidence: internal/app/plugins_services.go registers plugins.content.find and targets a string pane key or the active registered pluginContentController. TestOpenIDEAPluginServicesLogActionsRouteByTargetAndActivePane covers all three operations and both routes

action:plugins.log.toggleArgument.evidence: internal/app/plugins_services.go registers plugins.log.toggleArgument and applies strictly typed id/checked arguments to an existing toggle before restarting the native log stream. TestOpenIDEAPluginServicesLogActionsRouteByTargetAndActivePane covers the command arguments and restart

action:plugins.installFromDisk.evidence: internal/app/plugins_actions.go opens the native folder chooser or accepts a path argument, links the plugin into GoIDEA's isolated plugin folder and reloads its contributions; TestPluginActionsInstallFromDiskAndReload covers the action and installed link

action:plugins.importInstalledIntellijTh.evidence: internal/app/intellij_theme_actions.go groups the backend's installed JetBrains themes one row per plugin and opens the native plugins.intellijThemes chooser; TestIntellijThemeChooserLoadsAndRendersNativeOverlay covers loading, grouping and rendering

action:editor.colorScheme.${name}.evidence: internal/app/editor_scheme.go registers OpenIDEA's dynamic editor.colorScheme.${name} actions as native editor.colorScheme.import, editor.colorScheme.export and editor.colorScheme.delete commands with MyGo open/save and confirmation dialogs. The parser stores supported IntelliJ .icls colors and text attributes in global editor.customSchemes, editor.colorOverrides and editor.colorScheme through settings_set and Preferences.EditorScheme; export round-trips the same supported values. TestEditorSchemeActionsAreRegisteredAndToggled, TestParseAndExportICLSRoundTripsSupportedAttributes, TestColorSchemeImportPlanningAndChoices and TestImportColorSchemeWritesBackendAndLocalSettings cover the actions, parser, settings writes and overwrite/keep-both planning. MyGo has no per-token foreground API, so imported attributes are retained and exported rather than applied to token glyphs

action:editor.toggleRainbowBrackets.evidence: internal/app/editor_scheme.go registers editor.toggleRainbowBrackets with OpenIDEA's toggled state and persists editor.rainbowBrackets to global settings_set and local Preferences.EditorScheme. internal/app/editor_scheme_decorations.go scans brackets lexically, skips comments and strings, and feeds depth colors through MyGo editor.TextBackgrounds in the shared composeTextBackgrounds path. TestEditorSchemeActionsAreRegisteredAndToggled, TestEditorSchemeTogglePersistsGloballyAndLocally and TestRainbowBracketsUseDepthColorsAndSkipStrings cover registration, persistence and rendering

action:editor.toggleSemanticHighlighting.evidence: internal/app/editor_scheme.go registers editor.toggleSemanticHighlighting with OpenIDEA's toggled state and persists editor.semanticHighlighting globally and locally. internal/app/editor_scheme_decorations.go requests backend lsp_semantic_tokens, decodes the server legend and local/parameter modifiers, and tints matching local names by OpenIDEA's stable FNV palette through editor.TextBackgrounds. TestSemanticTokenSpansFilterLocalsAndUseUTF16Columns and TestSemanticHighlightingConsumesBackendTokens cover the real RPC consumer; MyGo exposes text backgrounds but no per-token foreground color, so foreground typography remains partial

setting:editor.semanticHighlighting.evidence: The native Color Scheme Language Defaults switch and editor.toggleSemanticHighlighting share editor.semanticHighlighting, persist it to global settings_set and Preferences.EditorScheme, and drive the verified lsp_semantic_tokens consumer. setting:editor.rainbowBrackets.evidence: The native Color Scheme Language Defaults switch and editor.toggleRainbowBrackets share editor.rainbowBrackets, persist it globally and locally, and drive MyGo editor.TextBackgrounds with three depth colors through the shared editor decoration composer.
